note: Hand-written input for src/torahread/tools/build-data.mjs. Glosses are ORIGINAL (written for this project, not copied from any dictionary, so no share-alike obligation attaches). They are short, literal and have NOT been reviewed by a Hebrew educator. Only meanings the author is sure of are given; an alternative reading with no gloss here is shown without one on purpose. Keys are consonant skeletons as written in the scroll. 'alts' maps a pointed form to its gloss.

את.gloss: marks the definite direct object (not translated into English)

alts.אֵת: the same object marker when it carries the stress; a different word meaning 'with' is spelled the same

יהוה.gloss: the divine name; read aloud as Adonai

alts.וַיֹּאמַר: and he said (a second pointing of the same spelling)

alts.הִוא: she, it: in the Torah the word for 'she' is usually spelled exactly like 'he' and is read hi

alts.לּוֹ: to him, for him (a second pointing)

אתו.gloss: him, it (as the object of a verb)

אתם.gloss: them (as the object of a verb)

ליהוה.gloss: to the LORD, for the LORD; read aloud as la-Adonai
